marks.gloss_en: מכלל דראשונים אף על פי שהיד סולדת בהן מותר -- if the limit is said of the final waters, the first waters are permitted even when the hand recoils
[on the final-waters clause:] they taught [only cold] only where the hand recoils; but where the hand does not recoil, one washes [with warm]
they taught [that the first waters may be hot] only where the hand does not recoil from them; but where the hand recoils, one does not wash with them
Rav Nachman: they taught [that the middle waters are optional] only between one dish and another
Rav Yehuda brei deR' Chiyya: why did they say the final waters are an obligation? because there is Sodomite salt, which blinds the eyes
Abaye: at first I would say that one does not wash the final waters onto the ground because of filth
Abaye: at first I would say that one does not take anything from the table when a person holds a cup to drink lest a mishap occur at the meal
and we said this only where he takes and does not return it; taking and returning -- we have no [objection] to it
Mar bar Rav Ashi was particular even about the mortar and pestle for spices -- things the meal needs
Abaye: at first I would say that people gather crumbs for cleanliness

the tale: the prince of poverty pursued a man and could not overcome him, for he was very careful with crumbs; once he broke bread over grass, and after eating he uprooted the grass with a hoe and threw it into the river
Abaye: at first I would say that one does not drink foam because it is repulsive
for catarrh from wine -- beer
Abaye: at first I would say that one does not eat vegetables from a bundle the gardener tied because it looks like gluttony
the tale: Rav Chisda and Rabba bar Rav Huna were travelling by boat; a matron asked to be seated with them and they refused; she said something and bound the boat; they said something and released it
Abaye: at first I would say that one does not eat vegetables that fell from the table because it is repulsive
the tale: porters carrying a barrel of wine set it down under a gutter to rest and it burst; they came before Mar bar Rav Ashi, who brought out horns and excommunicated [the demon]
Mar bar Rav Ashi: what are you doing in a place where the many are found? you are the one who deviated -- go and pay!
Abaye: at first I would say that one pours water from the mouth of the pitcher because of twigs
the demon's son in Rav Pappa's house, sent for water and delayed: [I waited] until the bad waters passed
